# Esther 10 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** Esther 10 (3 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 2

---

## V.1 — "coastlands" vs. "islands" vs. "coastal regions and islands"
- **EMET:** "islands of the sea" / **LOGOS:** "coastlands of the sea" / **PNEUMA:** "coastal regions and islands"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "coastlands of the sea" — *iyyey ha-yam* can mean islands or coastlands; "coastlands" is the standard biblical rendering and more inclusive.

---

## V.3 — "spoke peace to all his descendants" vs. "championed the well-being of all future generations"
- **EMET:** "speaking peace to all his seed" / **LOGOS:** "spoke peace to all his descendants" / **PNEUMA:** "championed the well-being of all future generations"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "spoke peace to all his descendants" — preserves the Hebrew idiom *dover shalom*, which has a specific nuance of official intercession. PNEUMA's paraphrase loses this.

---

*— SOPHIA*
